theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_st_lsc_tangent_range
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (ψ : Eucl m → Eucl (m + 1)) (Φ : Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl P) (h : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) (V : Set (Eucl m)) (c : ℝ) (v : Eucl m), IsOpen V → v ∈ V → 0 < c → DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ v → DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (ψ v) → DifferentiableAt ℝ h (ψ v) → fderiv ℝ h (ψ v) ≠ 0 → (∀ v' ∈ V, ∀ v'' ∈ V, c * ‖v' - v''‖ ≤ ‖ψ v' - ψ v''‖) → (∀ v' ∈ V, h (ψ v') = h (ψ v)) → LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (Φ ∘ ψ) v).toLinearMap = Submodule.map (fderiv ℝ Φ (ψ v)).toLinearMap (LinearMap.ker (fderiv ℝ h (ψ v)).toLinearMap)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
